MixSportsParlayBetSetting:
Mix Sports Parlay: The parlay whose tickets are not just soccer.
Example: Soccer - Soccer - Basketball, Tennis - Tennis - Tennis, Basketball - Golf - Football.
MPS1: - Max Payout Per Match is a setting that controls the total max payout of all tickets of the same match.
MPS10: - Max Payout setting is applied to all bet types of Sportsbook except the bet types listed in the table below. E-Sports and Muay Thai do not apply Max Payout setting.
MPS12: Bet types that do not apply Max Payout setting
MPS15: - The Saba Futsal uses the bet settings of Saba Soccer.
MPS16: - The Saba Cricket uses the bet settings of Other Sports.
MPS17: Accumulated max payout counts all running tickets. It will be released if any running tickets are settled/rejected/refunded/voided.
MPS18: The difference between Parlay Max Payout Per Bet and Parlay Max Payout Per Match
MPS19: - Parlay Max Payout Per Bet: This setting is used to calculate the max bet of each combo parlay in a single ticket.
MPS20: 1. Given that the Parlay Max Payout Setting is: Combo 2 = 500; Combo 3-5 = 1,000; Combo 6+ & System Parlay  = 2,000
MPS21: 2. If member makes 3 selections: A (odds = 2), B (odds = 3), C (odds = 4), the system will offer the following combos: Double (3 Bets), Treble (1 Bet), Trixie (4 Bets) and Lucky 7 (7 Bets)
MPS22: 3. Max Bet of 3 Double bets = Parlay Max Payout of Combo 2 / (odds AB + odds BC + odds AC) = 500 / (2*3 + 3*4 + 2*4) = 500 / 26 = 19
MPS23: 4. Max Bet of a Treble bet = Parlay Max Payout of Combo 3-5 / odds ABC = 1,000 / (2*3*4) = 1000 / 24 = 41
MPS24: 5. Max Bet of Trixie and Lucky 7 bets =  Parlay Max Payout of Combo 6+ & System Parlay / (odds Double + odds Treble) = 2,000 / (26 + 24) = 2000 / 50 = 40
MPS25: - Parlay Max Payout Per Match: The system accumulates the max payout of all running parlay tickets and uses it together with the setting value to calculate the next ticket max bet. The max bet calculation is different between Single Match Parlay and Mix/Combo Parlay.
MPS26:
+ Single Match Parlay: Max Bet = (Parlay Max Payout Per Match Setting - Accumulated Max Payout of the same match) / Odds
* Single Match Parlay does not count Mix/Combo Parlay ticket
MPS27:
+ Mix/Combo Parlay: Max Bet = (Parlay Max Payout Per Match Setting - Accumulated Max Payout of the all matches) / Odds
* Mix/Combo Parlay does not count Single Match Parlay tickets
MPS28: * For parlay, Max Payout is applied to all bet types.
MPS3: 1. Given that max payout per match = 1,000
MPS4: 2. If member places the first ticket with Odds = 10, Stake = 70, the ticket will have:
MPS5: - Max Bet = Max Payout Per Match / Odds = 1,000 / 10 = 100.
MPS6: - Max Payout = Stake * Odds = 70 * 10 = 700 = <i>Accumulated Max Payout*</i
MPS7: 3. If member places the second ticket with Odds = 5, the ticket will have:
MPS8: - Max Bet = (Max Payout Per Match - Accumulated Max Payout) / Odds = (1,000 - 700) / 5 = 60.
MPS9: * Accumulated Max Payout is the Max Payout of all tickets of the same match excludes the Void/Reject tickets. Therefore, if the first ticket is voided, Max Bet of the second ticket = (1,000 - 0)/5 = 200.
